about_the_game:
A little about the store. WARNING: Very biased. 

Enjoy shopping in our newly renovated store with prices you would not believe! Good news! Your store has granted you all sorts of ways to save money. Starting with a full reimbursement of your shopping list if you get all the items in time, or a bonus for picking up last minute decisions. Become a member today if you're interested in saving money (We know you are!). 

The best parts:

Booster your way to the checkout lane with fire extinguisher boosters.

Fly your way over the aisles with battery powered propellers.

Add a ram and pop cases to the bottom of your cart to increase stability and ram through wrecked aisles.

Go against your friends in local multiplayer for a fun challenging battle of getting what is asked first.

Customize your cart to your liking with every can of spray paint in the world to make your cart whatever color you want.

And of course, most important of all.... SAVE MONEY!!!! 

The not so good stuff:

Everything in the store is EXTREMELY overpriced. I mean like who would pay $40 for a bottle of ketchup. Not to mention (but still mentioning) the stores debt policy. Holding onto items to long will cause you to go into debt with the store.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: I5-4570 with 4 cores
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: intel integrated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: intel(R) Display audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: i5-7500 with 4 cores
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX550
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek(R) Audio

short_description: SAVING MONEY! That is the name of the game. From completing a shopping list to checking out with items on sale, you can save money! Which can then be used for more upgrades to your cart, making you a better shopper!
